bottleneck.description: Global market leader in conveyor rollers and drum motors with a broad platform (>60,000 SKUs) sold to system integrators, but in a component category where Van der Graaf, Rulmeca, Damon, Titan and dozens of regional suppliers offer direct substitutes.

dependency.key_customers: Conveyor system integrators serving Amazon, DHL, FedEx, Coca-Cola, P&G, Walmart, airport baggage handlers, supermarket checkouts, mining/aggregates
dependency.key_suppliers: Steel tube mills, bearing manufacturers (SKF, NSK, Schaeffler), copper wire, electronic motor controllers, rubber/poly belt material

editorial.notes: Conveyor rollers and drum motors are an established commodity-engineered category with multiple credible alternatives at every price point. Interroll's scale (~CHF 527M revenue, 36 subsidiaries) and platform breadth give it specification advantages with integrators, but switching to Van der Graaf, Rulmeca or regional alternatives is a parts-spec decision, not a multi-year qualification. Drum motor efficiency (~90%) is matched by peers. Maps to LOW (broad competitive component supply).
